t: You're outside Liverpool Street station, in front of Kindertransport – The Arrival, a bronze memorial by Frank Meisler. It commemorates the ten thousand Jewish children who escaped Nazi persecution and arrived at this station in 1938 and 1939. Meisler was born in the Free City of Danzig and grew up in England. The sculpture was installed in September 2006, replacing an earlier work, and was commissioned by World Jewish Relief and the Association of Jewish Refugees. It also depicts Sir Erich Reich, born in Vienna, who became a London businessman and charity fundraiser.
